invariants.rationale: A new HashMap is always assigned and returned, so result cannot be null.
writeResult is a required input parameter and not changed in the method.
Every key and value in the result map should be non-null if present.
If result is non-empty, all its values are non-null lists.
The result is assigned as either a new HashMap, or from context.mapToPair which likely returns a HashMap or compatible map, as per returned type.
